justification: Critical: corrects 15 served or stored SEPP rows in production to the law in force, changes which coverage findings the building-area card shows, and narrows the Inner West LEP clause-scope match.

pre_impl.existing_data: After the 2026-10-10 DQ-88 refresh, a second review (Sol on #1250 plus a figure-by-figure check of 491 served SEPP figures against the in-force text) found 15 rows wrong: stale Sch 7 standards, repealed sections still current, scan errors, a dropped limb, a wrong substituted definition, and three mid-word spans.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The refresh compared rows only with the law's changes since the 2025 PDFs, so text already stale in those PDFs was never examined; similarity matching could also pair a row with the wrong clause, as with 42131.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Five targets already had v1/v2 history and provision_versions is unique on (provision_id, version_number), so a next-version writer adds v3; rows without history reuse the existing version writer.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Every new text is copied from the legislation.nsw.gov.au in-force dump; one review finding (35305) was checked against that text and found wrong, so the row was left unchanged.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No frontend type change: corrected text arrives in the same provision_text field, and cap findings arrive as the gap strings the card already renders.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Without this, users were served a 15 m height limit the law now sets at 22m, 90mm where the law says 900mm, and a repealed electricity excavation clause as current law.

falsifiable_check.command: python scripts/dq88_review_fixes_2026_10_10.py ; python -m pytest tests/test_constraint_arithmetic.py tests/test_inner_west_lep_scope.py -q
falsifiable_check.fails_when: A planned row no longer holds the text the plan was built from, which makes the script refuse; or a cap finding is not shown when no cap applies; or a later Inner West LEP inherits the 2022 clause scopes.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Observed 2026-10-10: before the fixes the figure check listed rows 45825 (15m), 46345 and 46346 (90mm) and 43685 among unmatched served figures; after the apply none of the 15 appear. Re-running the script now refuses at the first row because its stored text changed -- the stale-text guard fires as designed.

functions.name: next_version
functions.input: a cursor, the provision id, the new text or None to retire, the in-force source URL, the reason and a timestamp
functions.output: closes the latest version, adds the next version, logs the change, and updates the provision row text or is_current
functions.if_none: text_after None retires the row (is_current FALSE) and keeps its last text as the new version's body.

functions.name: run
functions.input: a database connection and whether to commit, reading the plan file data/dq88_review_fixes_2026-10-10.json
functions.output: applies each planned row once and prints counts of retired and replaced rows, committing only with --apply
functions.if_none: Exits refusing if any row is missing, no longer current, or its stored text differs from the plan's old_text.

functions.name: compute_constraint_arithmetic
functions.input: lot and LEP inputs, the DCP controls, and the coverage findings for this council and housing type
functions.output: the arithmetic result; a cap finding now explains the missing cap when no site coverage, landscaping or deep soil figure applies
functions.if_none: With no findings the generic gap text is used, unchanged.

values.source: legislation.nsw.gov.au in-force text of the Biodiversity, Planning Systems and Transport SEPPs, read 2026-10-10

queries.purpose: latest version for the next-version writer

break_it.scenario: A planned row was edited by someone else between the plan and the apply, so the stale-text guard must catch it
break_it.what_happens: The script refuses and writes nothing for the batch, because the transaction is rolled back on exit

break_it.scenario: A row already has v1 and v2 history from the first refresh
break_it.what_happens: The next-version writer adds v3 instead of colliding with the unique (provision_id, version_number) key

break_it.scenario: A review finding is itself wrong and would replace correct law
break_it.what_happens: Each finding was checked against the in-force text first; 35305 was wrong and was left unchanged
break_it.how: manual check against the law dump before the plan

break_it.scenario: A cap finding hides behind setback findings and is never shown
break_it.what_happens: Shown when no site coverage, landscaping or deep soil figure applies

break_it.scenario: A future Inner West LEP document inherits the 2022 clause scopes
break_it.what_happens: Only document ids naming the 2022 plan match

post_merge.manual_verify: Already applied to production 2026-10-10 after a rolled-back dry run; nothing further to run. Backup: data/db_rollback_backups/regulatory_provisions_pre_dq88_review_fixes_2026-10-10.csv.

real_layer_exempt.scripts/dq88_review_fixes_2026_10_10.py: One-off production correction applied 2026-10-10 after a rolled-back dry run (15 rows: 8 replaced, 7 retired); re-running refuses by design.
